title: Kumar pays a vegetable vendor using UPI
body: Kumar buys vegetables from Piyush, a vendor at the local market. Instead of paying in cash, Kumar opens a payment application on his mobile phone and scans the QR code displayed at Piyush's stall. He types the amount to be paid and then enters his UPI PIN. The application sends a payment request to Kumar's bank. Kumar's bank forwards the request to the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI). NPCI decrypts the request, verifies Kumar's UPI PIN and processes the transfer. The funds are then received by Piyush's bank, and within a few seconds Piyush receives the payment in his bank account. Both Kumar and Piyush can later check the transaction and their balances on their phones, without visiting a bank or updating a passbook.
